# T-014 · Tab "Đã xong" trống thì app bảo mình chưa có việc nào

> Dữ liệu mẫu cho demo, không phải người dùng thật. Lỗi này do người chạy demo **cài vào có chủ ý** (demo SDLC-4), xem commit gài bug.

- Người gửi: Vy (người dùng, gửi qua form góp ý)
- Ngày: 2026-10-29
- Lượt +1: 1

Mình có 4 việc, chưa xong việc nào. Bấm tab "Đã xong" thì app hiện "Chưa có việc nào. Nếu có file sao lưu, hãy bấm Nhập từ file".
Mình hết hồn tưởng mất hết, suýt bấm nhập file sao lưu cũ đè lên. Quay lại tab "Tất cả" thì 4 việc vẫn còn.
12:- **U1.** Never lose the user's data silently. Any failed save is shown on the same screen, in plain words, with what the user can do
14:- **U2.** No confirmation dialogs for actions on a single item: they happen at once and offer **Undo** for 10 seconds instead.
17:- **U3.** Every list or screen defines its empty, loading and error states.
18:- **U4.** UI text is Vietnamese, short, and free of technical words (no "localStorage", "JSON", "console").
19:- **U5.** Every control works with the keyboard and has an accessible label.

content.text:
I fixed it. When a tab has nothing in it but the list still has tasks, the app no longer shows the "Chưa có việc nào… Nhập từ file" message. That message now appears only when the list is truly empty. I sized this as **Small** (one bug, one place in the code), so there's no committed plan.

**Cause:** `app/app.js` chose the empty-state message from the filtered list. It always showed the "import a backup" text, so an empty "Đã xong" tab looked like lost data.

**Fix:**
- In `app/backup.js` I added two messages: `emptyDone` ("Chưa có việc nào đã xong.") and `emptyOpen` ("Không còn việc nào chưa xong.").
- In `app/app.js`, `render()` now picks the message each time. If the list is truly empty it shows `emptyList`, which still points to "Nhập từ file". Otherwise it shows the message for the current tab. The one-time line at startup that set the text is gone.

**Test first:** I added `a filter tab with nothing in it does not say the list is empty (T-014, Vy)` to `tests/app.test.js`, plus two small helpers in that file so the test can click a filter tab and read `#empty`. Before the fix it failed with Vy's exact situation: four open tasks, "Đã xong" tab, and the app showed `'Chưa có việc nào. Nếu có file sao lưu, hãy bấm "Nhập từ file".'` instead of `'Chưa có việc nào đã xong.'`. After the fix:

```
ℹ tests 43
ℹ pass 43
ℹ fail 0
== lint: node --check app/*.js tests/*.js
== check: OK
```

**Notes:**
- **Wording to confirm:** the two new sentences are my wording; no ticket or spec gave any. A person should approve them under the UX policy.
- **Related bug not fixed:** T-013, which was planted in the same commit, is still there. The count line at `app/app.js:51` counts only the tasks in the current tab, so "Đã xong" always shows "0 việc chưa xong". Vy didn't report that, so I left it as a separate fix.
- **Nothing is committed.** Per the repo rules, a person should commit the test first and then the fix.
